gif.zh: 生成 {frame_count} 帧 GIF 动图，每帧间隔 {frame_duration_ms} 毫秒：将上述描述中的动作表现为连续运动，首尾无缝衔接并循环播放。不要输出静态图片。
gif.en: Generate an animated GIF with {frame_count} frames and a delay of {frame_duration_ms} milliseconds per frame. Show the described actions as continuous motion, with a seamless loop connecting the last frame to the first. Do not output a still image.
